description: Different model profiles should preserve settings-owned KMP module ownership, qualified target tasks, and source-set-aware cross-module evidence.

lockedFields.reason: Every supported KMP child contributes its module-qualified JVM target test task.
The settings-owned all-KMP aggregate and its direct source-set dependency are inside the bounded slice.
The untested common formatter remains the only add-test item.
Common and JVM-specific dependency sources both retain extend-test recommendations.
The dependency module's JVM validator keeps its stable target identity.
The dependent module's named JVM test source set supplies target-specific evidence.
The JVM validator result is consumed by a kotlin.test assertion.
The uncovered dependency-module formatter remains an add-test item.
The common parser is covered through the dependent module's commonTest source set.
Common cross-module evidence must preserve its commonTest owner.

unexpectedVariations: cross-module evidence without a source-set-visible project dependency
